spans.text: Skill Set
Switching
-Backup and restore device configuration.
-Cisco IOS upgrades and recovery (FTP, TFTP)
-Troubleshoot connectivity issue, verify and validate Link errors, CRC Errors.
-Monitor Switch availability or any other error and perform Triage with the respective team to
resolve the issue.
-Carry out standard changes related to desktop ports.
-Carry out standard configuration on switch according to the template.
-Carry out VLAN mapping to the interface, port mapping.
-VLAN configuration over switches and make machines communicate in LAN & WAN
connectivity.
-LAN technologies - Ethernet, Fast Ethernet, Gigabit Ethernet.
-perform port aggregation & Link configuration: Access/Trunk.
-Configuration and troubleshooting of VLANs, inter-VLAN routing, Interswitch connectivity.
-Configuration and troubleshooting of Trunk ports, VTP (v1&v2).
-Configuration and troubleshooting of STP protocols and STP protection.
-Implemented CDP, LLDP
, EtherChannel.
-Configuration HSRP, VRRP.
Routing
-Backup and restore device configuration
-Troubleshoot network connectivity issues using ICMP, ping, and traceroute
-Monitor routers and links for hardware and performance issues.
-Triage for Link issues with appropriate vendors.
-Troubleshooting, overutilization, Reachability, VPN connectivity.
-Apply standard SOP based configuration on the router.(AAA,TACACS,Radius,Banner,VPN
Configurations)
-Configuration of NAT/PAT,ACL
-Configuration/Troubleshoot of Static, Dynamic (OSPF & EIGRP), and Default Routing
protocols.
-Configure, verify, and troubleshoot IPv4 addressing, Subnetting,Supernetting, ARP, and
Route Summarization
-Basics of BGP
Firewall: -
-Restore and backup device settings
-Used Fortinet Manager to Upgrades/installs OS to Fortigate Firewalls in accordance with
recommendations to maintain them up to date.
-Using FortiManager, provision firewall policies on Fortinet FortiGate appliances.
-Implementing rules to allow or restrict IPs, and creating policies in response to requests from
business users.
-FortiGate CPE 40/60/80/100 series Firewall configuration, management, and FortiAnalyzer
series 4000 (logging and reporting server), FortiManager series 3000/4000 (centralized
control) firewalls
-Analyze the logs and troubleshoot any connectivity problems.
WLAN
-Monitor WAP, and Triage issue with respective teams.
-Troubleshooting Connectivity issue from an end-user perspective.
-Troubleshooting the WAP isolation issue, Cannot Connect to SSID,Slow Performance,
Intermittent Disconnections
